svg.title: Where 21 peptides and NAD+ stand with FDA (October 24, 2026)
svg.desc: Committee voted to add in July 2026; FDA staff recommended against (final decision pending): BPC-157, KPV, TB-500, MOTS-c, Semax, Epitalon; Committee voted against in July 2026; FDA staff also against: DSIP (emideltide); Committee voted against in 2024, as FDA proposed: CJC-1295, Ipamorelin, Thymosin alpha-1; On the next committee agenda, due before the end of February 2027: GHK-Cu, LL-37, Dihexa, Melanotan II, PEG-MGF; Nomination withdrawn, on FDA’s safety-risk page, no meeting announced: Selank; FDA category 1, “under evaluation”: Glutathione, NAD+ (not a peptide), GHK-Cu, non-injectable only; Ingredient of an FDA-approved drug: PT-141 (Vyleesi), SS-31 (Forzinity), Tesamorelin (Egrifta), Sermorelin (Geref, discontinued)

text.font-family: Inter, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
